footprints.description: Alps SKRT 4.5 x 3.4 mm side push SMD tact switch, 3 terminal lands as 2 pins
footprints.note: PdfFile_191666.pdf p.1 PC board mounting hole and land dimensions (viewed from switch mounting face): three terminal lands in a row, 3.2 outside, outer lands 0.75 wide, centre land 0.6 wide, 1.8 high from the guide-boss hole line towards the rear -> x -1.225 / 0 / +1.225. The datasheet has 3 terminals and its Circuit Diagram joins 1 and 3 against 2, so this is drawn as pins 2 with pin 1 on BOTH outer lands (datasheet terminals 1 and 3) and pin 2 on the centre land (as the C&K PTS845 / E-Switch TL3340 3-terminal parts). Not drawn: the two 1.2-high fixing lands (5 outside / 2.4 inside, front edge), the hatched no-copper area and the 2-dia 0.9 guide-boss holes (SKRTLAE010 only). Body: housing 4.5 x 2.56 (3.4 with the 0.84 stem, at the bottom edge); boss line 2.05 - 0.84 = 1.21 behind the housing front -> y = 1.28 - 1.21 = 0.07; lands y 0.07 to -1.73, centre -0.83
